title: WASSCE Components of Mobile Phone - Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1 - Software Components
subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: Android is a popular example of which kind of software component on a mobile phone?
questions.explain: Android is a mobile OS that manages phone hardware and provides services for applications.
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: Which of the following best defines 'Firmware' in the context of mobile phone software?
options: A protective physical casing installed around the phone.
Software permanently or semi-permanently written to the phone's read-only memory, responsible for low-level hardware control.
Applications downloaded by the user from an app store.
A specialized battery management integrated circuit.
questions.explain: Firmware serves as the critical bridge between the hardware components and higher-level software applications, often governing low-level device functions.
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: When a technician completely rewrites the firmware on a malfunctioning mobile device using a computer and specific flash tools, this process is generally termed:
questions.explain: 'Flashing' refers to overwriting the flash memory module with a fresh firmware image to resolve deep software corruption.
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: User-installed software like WhatsApp or games fall under which category in the mobile phone ecosystem?
questions.explain: Applications are end-user programs that run on top of the mobile Operating System.
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: iOS is an operating system exclusively developed and utilized by which technology company?
questions.explain: Apple develops and retains exclusive rights to the iOS operating system used in their mobile devices.
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: When comparing mobile Operating Systems, a primary difference is that Android is an 'open-source' project, whereas iOS is considered:
questions.explain: Apple's iOS is closed-source, meaning its core code is not freely available for public viewing or modification, contrasting with Android.
